reasoning: Spot identification: 4WF-RANGE-AS-357, flop, hero BTN closing action 3-way SRP, board 5s8s3h two-tone spades, holding AcQs. Preflop: MP opens 2.5bb, CO flats, hero BTN flats, blinds fold. Net: roughly 30-35% value, 65-70% denial/air bluffs. CO (cold-called between, range-capped, no AA/KK/AK that would 3-bet): suited connectors 65s-T9s, mid pairs 66-JJ, suited broadway. Spot-specific factors: hero IP-closing, no players behind (CO acted second, will check-fold most of range; SB/BB folded preflop). SPR ~13 (150bb stacks), so plenty of room to realize on turn/river. The Qs gives a soft spade-board blocker, slightly reducing villain spade FDs. Sonnet-split analysis: four Sonnets correctly call (labeller 5 incorrectly folds, conflating 'no pair no FD' with 'no equity' — but two clean overcards + backdoor equity + closing position vs a merged 26% bet easily meets the 17% threshold and realizes well IP). The fold line discards a structurally profitable call. Decision: CALL — BTN closing with overcards + backdoor + position is a default call vs merged c-bets. RAISE is dominated (charges out CO floats that hero already beats by air, isolates vs MP's stronger continuing range); FOLD bleeds EV given pot odds and realization.

The call line realizes the 9 flush outs cleanly and keeps BTN's dominated FDs in. RAISE is at best a mix-frequency line (~20%); CALL is the dominant pure strategy with BTN-behind. Decision: CALL. FOLD discards a +EV draw against a merged 26% c-bet; RAISE leaks against the live BTN. Bottom pair adds slight SDV equity to the FD's drawing equity, making the call clearly profitable.

Spot identification: 4WF-RANGE-AS-369, flop, hero BTN IP-closing, 3-way SRP, board QcJh2d (rainbow with one diamond), holding KdQd. Preflop: UTG opens 2.5bb, MP flats, hero BTN flats. Decision: CALL — three streets of pot control IP, dominate UTG's bluff catchers and KJ second-pair, plus realize backdoor diamond FD freely. Raising leaks against the polar response distribution; folding is absurd with TPTK + position. Despite the Sonnet majority for raise, the call is GTO-correct.
